question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
WITH director_movies AS (
  SELECT 
    dm.name_id,
    m.id as movie_id,
    m.date_published,
    m.duration,
    r.avg_rating,
    r.total_votes,
    r.median_rating,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dm.name_id ORDER BY m.date_published) as rn
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
  JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
inter_movie AS (
  SELECT 
    name_id,
    movie_id,
    date_published,
    duration,
    avg_rating,
    total_votes,
    median_rating,
    rn,
    LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
  FROM director_movies
),
inter_duration AS (
  SELECT 
    name_id,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(CASE 
      WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_published - prev_date)) / 86400
      ELSE NULL
    END), 0)) AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration
  FROM inter_movie
  GROUP BY name_id
),
director_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    dm.name_id,
    COUNT(*) as movie_count,
    SUM(m.duration) as total_duration,
    AVG(r.avg_rating) as avg_rating,
    SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes,
    MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
    MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
  JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
  GROUP BY dm.name_id
)
SELECT 
  ds.name_id,
  n.name,
  CAST(ds.movie_count AS INTEGER) as movie_count,
  id.avg_inter_movie_duration,
  CAST(ROUND(ds.avg_rating, 2) AS DOUBLE) as avg_rating,
  CAST(ds.total_votes AS BIGINT) as total_votes,
  ds.min_rating,
  ds.max_rating,
  CAST(ds.total_duration AS BIGINT) as total_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN names n ON ds.name_id = n.id
LEFT JOIN inter_duration id ON ds.name_id = id.name_id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
